comment: Hashes (LF-normalised sha256) of the two files that the live Deployment litellm (namespace llm, volume config) must mount BEFORE this repository's files are rolled out by stage DeployLitellmSidecar. Update this file in each reviewed change that edits context_forwarder.py or long_context_callbacks.py: put the previous release's hashes here. If the live files differ, the stage refuses to apply (unreviewed source baseline).
